ChannelSummary.samples: count: samples searched, each config.sample_interval_s long
ChannelSummary.ceiling_samples: count: samples at which the ceiling dropped at least one story
ChannelSummary.live_histogram: counts: samples, by the number of live stories after pruning, in bins of 10 stories: entry k counts the samples with 10 k to 10 k + 9 live stories
ChannelSummary.live_mean_stories: stories: the mean number of live stories after pruning over the channel's samples: the means of the 0.1 s windows (round(0.1 s / config.sample_interval_s) samples each, the last one the rest of the samples) weighted by their samples
ChannelSummary.live_max_stories: stories: the largest number of live stories after pruning at any sample
ChannelSummary.lines: count: the newborn lines (line 0 is the channel's first story)
ChannelSummary.fates: counts: the newborn lines by fates[kind][end][ended_in_first_element][led], 3 x 4 x 2 x 2 integers: kind is an index into line_kinds, end an index into line_ends, ended_in_first_element and led are 0 (false) or 1 (true; led: first_led_s is not null); fate_axes names the axes
ChannelSummary.led_lines: columns: the lines that ever led (first_led_s is not null), in the order of their ids, as the members of NewbornLine and the line's id as line; no other line is kept

NewbornLine.line: count: the line's id, its position among the channel's lines in the full form (version 1); ascending
NewbornLine.birth_s: s: the stream time of the sample at which the line was created (line 0: the first sample's)
NewbornLine.kind: code into line_kinds: how the line began (Start: line 0, the channel's first story, in the no-signal state; Silence: a newborn from silence, an over starts; Rescue: a rescue newborn, the sender begins a new story at a letter start)
NewbornLine.first_led_s: s or null: the stream time of the first sample after whose pruning one of the line's stories was the best; null if none ever was
NewbornLine.largest_deficit_nats: nats: how far the line's best story was behind the best, at most, after the pruning of each sample from its birth until it first led, or over its life if it never led; at its birth sample the newborn's own deficit, even where the newborn did not survive that sample
NewbornLine.end: code into line_ends: which step removed the line's last story (Alive while it has one; Merge: merged into a better story of its state; Beam: more than beam_nats behind the best; Ceiling: beyond the ceiling's best stories)
NewbornLine.end_s: s or null: the stream time of the sample at which the line's last story was removed; null while it is alive
NewbornLine.ended_in_first_element: true or false: the line's last story was removed before any story of the line had left the newborn's first mark (false for line 0)
